title: Towards LLM-Enhanced Android Taint Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.24269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Taint analysis is a fundamental technique for detecting sensitive data leaks in Android apps. However, traditional static tools, such as FlowDroid, still face well-known challenges due to the complexity of accurately modeling the Android framework. In this paper, we investigate whether off-the-shelf Large Language Models (LLMs) can effectively reason about taint flows in Android apps. Our preliminary approach relies on an agentic interaction strategy, enabling the LLM to iteratively explore code and reason about data flows.   We conduct an initial evaluation on the DroidBench benchmark against FlowDroid, where our approach outperforms the baseline: Gemini-3 Flash achieves an F1-score of 0.96, compared to 0.55 for FlowDroid. translated_title: 面向Android污点分析的LLM增强方法
translated_abstract: 污点分析是检测Android应用中敏感数据泄露的基础技术。然而，传统的静态工具（如FlowDroid）由于准确建模Android框架的复杂性，仍面临众所周知的挑战。本文研究了现成的大语言模型（LLMs）能否有效推理Android应用中的污点流。我们的初步方法依赖于一种代理交互策略，使LLM能够迭代探索代码并推理数据流。我们在DroidBench基准上对FlowDroid进行了初步评估，我们的方法优于基线：Gemini-3 Flash的F1分数达到0.96，而FlowDroid为0.55。特别地，我们在具有挑战性的类别中观察到改进，如组件间通信（0.95对0.17）、隐式流（0.94对0.00）和反射（1.00对0.50），这些正是FlowDroid通常表现不佳的领域。
tldr: 本文提出一种利用大语言模型通过代理交互策略增强Android污点分析的方法，在DroidBench基准上显著优于FlowDroid，特别是在组件间通信、隐式流和反射等传统难点上取得大幅提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-enhanced approach for Android taint analysis using an agentic interaction strategy, significantly outperforming FlowDroid on DroidBench, especially in challenging categories like inter-component communication, implicit flows, and reflection.
